Theo R: Quick: we need a fresh angle for the benchmark launch post + webinar. proposal: 'latency budgets meet unit economics' 1 focus on a decision point for PMs (pick a budget, see costs).
Ivy C: Nice. Product teams want a playbook: tell them how to pick budgets (e.g., p95=200ms for interactive, p95=500ms for async) and show cost options. keep copy non-technical.
Sam B: Agree. Visuals: 1) left = CDF (latency ms) across 4 configs; 2) mid = heatmap (configs vs common budgets, pass/fail); 3) right = $/1k tokens bar annotated with quantization and batching callouts.
Priya N: For authenticity, here's a tiny bench sample (anonymized):
```
config,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,p999_ms,usd_per_1k
fast-q8,42,150,280,360,0.29
balanced-fp16,58,210,430,760,0.47
slow-fp16,85,380,720,1400,0.50
batch-quant,125,340,610,1180,0.16
```
Theo R: Perfect spread. Marketing copy idea: "Set a latency budget. We'll show the configs that meet it and the cost tradeoffs so you can decide."
Ivy C: Add one short customer vignette: "Team Z tightened p99 from ~720ms to ~280ms and cut token spend ~22% using prefix cache + fastpath." anonymize and round.
Sam B: Designer notes: CDF x-axis linear to 2s, mark p50/p95/p99/p999; heatmap uses green for within budget, amber for borderline, red for fail. Bars should be simple with short labels. use accessible colors.
Priya N: Ops note: attach bench commit SHA and dataset slice in post notes. commit = d4f8e12, dataset = prod-chat-2026-03-sample. I'll drop the full CSV in ops.
WebinarBot: registration -> https://redwood.ai/webinar-budget-econ (auto-post) :calendar:
Theo R: Action items: Ivy write hero + 3 social variants by EOD; Sam handoff visual spec to design; Priya post CSV+SHA in ops; I'll review and finalize the slide hero. Any objections?
Ivy C: on it. will keep language customer-centric and short.
Sam B: will create the mock and ping design.
Priya N: uploading CSV to ops now, will post link in this thread once done.
Theo R: If no objections, we go with the budget-driven hook. thanks all. :rocket:
